run.question:
You are an SRE agent tasked with diagnosing issues in a Kubernetes application.

Application: Hotel Reservation
Namespace: hotel-reservation

A hotel reservation application built with Go and gRPC, providing backend in-memory and persistent databases, a recommender system for hotel recommendations, and a functionality to place reservations.

CRITICAL: You are running in an AUTOMATED environment. Work autonomously and make all decisions yourself. DO NOT ask for user confirmation or approval. Proceed with the best solution based on your analysis.

TASK: DIAGNOSIS
- Investigate the application to detect any anomalies or issues
- Analyze metrics, logs, and traces
- When ready, submit a natural language description of the issue you found
- Your diagnosis is evaluated on whether you correctly identify the faulty components and root cause

Important:
- You can query metrics and traces through the available observability tools

report.summary: The hotel-reservation namespace contains a ResourceQuota named memory-limit-quota (namespace hotel-reservation) whose creationTimestamp is 2026-11-21T15:14:26Z. It declares hard memory=1Gi and, per its admission behaviour, requires every new container to declare a memory limit. The search Deployment's container hotel-reserv-search declares only limits.cpu=1 and requests.cpu=100m, with no memory entry. At 15:14:26Z the running search pod search-567bb6c4b8-5df4b was stopped (Killing event), and from 15:14:27Z its ReplicaSet search-567bb6c4b8 failed ten pod creations with 'is forbidden: failed quota: memory-limit-quota: must specify memory for: hotel-reserv-search'. Today the Deployment 'search' has unavailableReplicas=1 with a ReplicaFailure condition carrying that message, no search pod exists among the namespace's 18 pods, and the search Service has an empty endpoint list. In Jaeger, frontend spans show HTTP GET /hotels returning 500 (http.status_code=500, otel.status_code=ERROR) with a child /search.Search/Nearby client span erroring on the same traces, while HTTP GET /recommendations returned 200 in the same sample and profile/recommendation server spans carried no error status. So hotel search (/hotels) is broken end-to-end because the search workload cannot get a pod admitted under the new quota; the other 18 hotel-reservation Deployments still report one available replica. Facts are from Kubernetes objects/events and a Jaeger trace sample; Prometheus had no samples for the trace/HTTP metrics in the queried hour, so no quantitative error-rate baseline exists, and it is unknown which actor created the quota or stopped the pod.

claims.text: A ResourceQuota named memory-limit-quota exists in namespace hotel-reservation with metadata.creationTimestamp 2026-11-21T15:14:26Z.
ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota declares spec.hard memory=1Gi and status.hard memory=1Gi with status.used memory=0 (no scopes or selectors are present in its spec).

The search Deployment's container hotel-reserv-search declares resources requests.cpu=100m and limits.cpu=1 only; it declares no memory request or memory limit, which is what the quota admission requires.

Ten ReplicaSet events for search-567bb6c4b8 between 15:14:27Z and 15:14:28Z report 'Error creating: pods "search-567bb6c4b8-..." is forbidden: failed quota: memory-limit-quota: must specify memory for: hotel-reserv-search' (reason FailedCreate), and the search Deployment's status carries a ReplicaFailure condition with the same message plus unavailableReplicas=1.

Pod search-567bb6c4b8-5df4b was scheduled, created and started at 15:14:15Z-15:14:16Z on sregym-worker3 and then received a Killing event 'Stopping container hotel-reserv-search' at 15:14:26Z; no OOMKilled, BackOff or crash-loop reason appears in its events.

The namespace-wide pod listing returned 18 pods (all Running and ready) and none of them is a search pod; the only search ReplicaSet present is search-567bb6c4b8 with readyReplicas unset, owned by Deployment search.

The Service 'search' in hotel-reservation has an empty endpoint set, while the other 18 Services in the namespace (frontend, profile, recommendation, reservation, user, geo, rate, mongodb-*, memcached-*, consul, jaeger-out) each list at least one address.

In the Jaeger sample of frontend traces (window 14:15:00Z-15:14:40Z, newest traces around 15:14:39.7Z-15:14:40Z), span group 'HTTP GET /hotels' had 21 rows all with http.status_code=500 and otel.status_code=ERROR, and span group '/search.Search/Nearby' had 21 rows all with otel.status_code=ERROR; each /search.Search/Nearby span is a CHILD_OF the /hotels span in the same trace (e.g. trace 6aea3de5939069d9).

In the same trace sample, span group 'HTTP GET /recommendations' had 9 rows with http.status_code=200 and zero error rows, and frontend client spans to /profile.Profile/GetProfiles and /recommendation.Recommendation/GetRecommendations as well as the profile and recommendation server spans carried no error status; no search service spans appear anywhere in the sample or in Jaeger's service list (frontend, profile, recommendation, reservation, user).

At the time of query, 18 of the 19 hotel-reservation Deployments reported availableReplicas=1 and readyReplicas=1 (consul, frontend, geo, jaeger, memcached-profile/rate/reserve, mongodb-geo/profile/rate/recommendation/reservation/user, profile, rate, recommendation, reservation, user); Deployment 'search' was the only one without available replicas.

The only up{job="hotel-reservation-application"} sample returned in the last hour is at 15:14:40Z with value 0 for instance rate.hotel-reservation:9091 and for instance search.hotel-reservation:9092 (a single point, no earlier baseline).

Frontend application logs for pod frontend-68745cb99c-hjtq8 contain consul connection-refused lines for srv-search, srv-profile, srv-recommendation and srv-user only between 15:14:13Z and 15:14:14Z, followed by 'Successfull' and 'Serving http' at 15:14:15Z; no further error lines are present through the last captured line.

Root cause of the failed hotel search: ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota in namespace hotel-reservation, created 2026-11-21T15:14:26Z, rejects the creation of the search pod with 'failed quota: memory-limit-quota: must specify memory for: hotel-reserv-search', so Deployment search never regains a replica, Service search keeps an empty endpoint list and frontend HTTP GET /hotels fails with 500 on its /search.Search/Nearby call.

Because every hotel-reservation Deployment in the namespace declares only cpu request/limit and no memory limit, the same quota would block any future pod creation or rescheduling for the other 18 workloads as well; this has not been observed as a failure in this window, only the search Deployment was scaled at 15:14:27Z.

Object-level state shows the rest of the application up: 18 Deployments report one available/ready replica and the namespace's 18 pods are Running and ready with 0 restarts; the /hotels failure is therefore not a namespace-wide outage in the sampled evidence.

The consul 'connection refused' errors in frontend logs are not the cause of the /hotels 500s: they occur only at 15:14:13Z-15:14:14Z before the frontend reported 'Serving http' at 15:14:15Z, they name srv-user/srv-profile/srv-recommendation as well as srv-search, and those other services served successful spans (HTTP GET /recommendations 200, profile/recommendation spans without error) while the only erroring downstream call is /search.Search/Nearby to a Service with no endpoints.

A crash, OOM kill or application error inside the search container is not what left search unavailable: the pod's events show Started followed by a Killing event with no OOMKilled/BackOff/Failed reason, and the failure to come back is explicitly an admission rejection by quota memory-limit-quota on the ReplicaSet.

Add an explicit memory request and memory limit (e.g. requests.memory and limits.memory) to the hotel-reserv-search container so it satisfies memory-limit-quota, or relax/adjust the quota (hard memory=1Gi) if it was not intended for that container; then confirm a search pod is Running, the search Service gains an endpoint, and frontend HTTP GET /hotels stops returning 500.

gaps: Change history is not integrated in this Run, so which actor or controller created ResourceQuota memory-limit-quota at 2026-11-21T15:14:26Z and which actor stopped pod search-567bb6c4b8-5df4b in the same second cannot be determined; the quota's creation timestamp and the pod's Killing event coincide but the applying identity is unknown.

No Prometheus samples existed for traces_span_metrics_calls_total or traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds in the queried hour (queries returned nothing, and get_metric_names for {__name__=~"traces_.*|http_.*|rpc_.*"} returned nothing), so no quantitative error rate, request count or latency baseline is available; the frontend failure evidence is a Jaeger sample covering roughly 15:14:39.7Z-15:14:40Z, not a failure-rate measurement.
Logs of the terminated search pod search-567bb6c4b8-5df4b cannot be read (pod no longer exists), so whether the container logged an internal error before termination is unknown.
Error-filtered log queries on pods rate-65d6967c95-q85zt (24 lines read) and geo-d4c78b89b-hfh27 (20 lines read) returned no matching lines; that is a no_data view and cannot prove absence of errors.

The single up{job="hotel-reservation-application"} sample is 0 for both rate.hotel-reservation:9091 and search.hotel-reservation:9092 at 15:14:40Z; with no earlier point this cannot show whether the rate metrics target is down or merely starting, so rate service health is unverified.

The networkpolicies query for hotel-reservation returned no objects (no_data view), so absence of a NetworkPolicy as a cause is unchecked rather than excluded; the empty search endpoints already explain the refused /search.Search/Nearby call.
Consequences for end users beyond the observed HTTP 500 responses on frontend /hotels (e.g. abandoned bookings, customer-visible error rates) were not measured by any tool in this Run.
next_steps: Add memory requests/limits to the hotel-reserv-search container (or exclude it/adjust the quota) and verify the search Deployment reaches 1/1 available with a Service endpoint.

Check whether memory-limit-quota was meant to apply to the whole hotel-reservation namespace; if not, remove it, since the other 18 workloads' pod templates also lack memory limits and would be blocked on any future reschedule.
Re-check frontend /hotels error spans and search availability after remediation, and keep the search error/latency series in Prometheus monitored once those metrics start being scraped.
